phase_prompt.label: Default
phase_prompt.summary: The Leader stands at the threshold of the season, a stoic administrator of time checking the system diagnostics before a gate transition.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic medium shot of a celestial administrator standing before a massive, dark gate structure. The subject has skin resembling rough basalt stone and wears heavy, layered robes made of black cabling and industrial fabric. They are looking down at a rectangular slate of transparent glass held in their hands, upon which glowing amber Geez script is vertically scrolling. The light from the tablet casts a warm, under-lit glow on their severe, tired features, highlighting the pores and weathering on their face. The background is a void of dark mechanical shapes, suggesting a vast, enclosed machine. The depth of field is shallow, focusing entirely on the character's expression of concentration and burden. Cinematic lighting, dramatic shadows, photorealistic details.
